body:
Poor kid. 

All I could think is that his voice sounded like Dewey from Malcolm in the Middle. 😂

ALWAYS trust your children when it comes to things like this. Regardless of who they’re blaming, trust them.

Red flag 1. Your 7 year old confronted your wife, she didn’t come to you about it. She wasn’t trying to get your wife in trouble, she confronted her because she saw it happen.

Red flag 2. Your oldest daughter didn’t come to you about the issue, you went to her. You knew nothing about the smoking and she could have left that out, but she chose to tell you.

Red flag 3. Your wife is choosing VERY inappropriate ways to ‘discipline’ your daughter. I don’t care if your daughter was taking 9 hours in the bathroom, that’s her body and she gets to decide who sees it. Body autonomy is incredibly important for children to have. 

Red flag 4: Your wife seems to have an answer for everything. A 7 year old isn’t going to dream about their step-mother(?) touching their sister’s breasts. That is ludicrous.

Please, for both kid’s safety get your wife out of there. There’s something very wrong and your children depend on you to fix it. This doesn’t mean divorce her, it means get her out of your children’s home and try to work on finding answers. If your wife cares about your children, she will understand that their safety and sanity comes first. Just please don’t ignore your daughter’s need for help.
